messages:
alex: Starting canary for v1.9.3 -> 10% traffic (eu-west). Deploy-bot triggered. Please watch SLO dashboards and error channels.

deploy-bot: canary rollout started: v=1.9.3 -> 10% traffic. Health checks: ok. Links: https://console.redwood/rollouts/1.9.3

maria: seeing p95 latency jump on embed-service for canary hosts, +220ms compared to baseline. CPU on GPU nodes looks normal. :thinking:

jordan: which metric? request_latency.p95 or inference.latency.p95?

maria: inference.latency.p95. spike concentrated at seq_len>512 requests. sample trace: `trace://abc123`

sam: adding note — QPS stable, error rate stable, but tail latency elevated. Could be KV cache miss due to new model kv layout.

jordan: possible. Did we change kv cache serialization in v1.9.3? I thought only kernel selection patch.

alex: v1.9.3 includes kernel tweak + optional kv-compact flag enabled by default. Maybe that flag flipped cache warms.

maria: repro: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/gen -d '{"model":"rwd-13b","input":"..."}'` latency 1.1s vs 0.85s baseline

jordan: propose: pause rollout, pin traffic back to v1.9.2 for eu-west, run quick perf probe on canary nodes to verify kv-cache behavior

alex: +1. Sam, can you run the rollback/pin? ops-bot will handle routes.

ops-bot: Received intent: traffic-pin -> v1.9.2 for service embed-service in eu-west. Executing...

ops-bot: Traffic pin completed. Canary halted at 0% for eu-west. Old version traffic restored.

maria: confirmed p95 back to baseline after pin. Good.

jordan: I'll spin up canary nodes with kv-compact disabled and re-run perf harness 15m window

alex: filing postmortem note and flagging change for kv-compact default in release notes. Also updating rollout checklist to include seq_len>512 perf probes.

maria: can we add a smokecheck to test tails for seq len distribution before traffic shift? maybe a small synthetic load: `ab -n 100 -c 5 -p payload_seq512.json`

sam: noted. I'll open an action item and assign to eng-runtime.

alex: thanks all. keeping this thread for postmortem snippets.
